articles.title: thurstone added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new object-oriented toolkit has been developed, addressing the 'horserace inverse problem.' This involves inferring relative ability from market prices, also known as the 'ability transform,' utilizing lattice-based performance models. This package aims to streamline complex data analysis, providing a structured approach to derive insights from market dynamics and performance predictions for various applications.

articles.title: Russia hits Ukraine with Oreshnik missile in one of war's biggest attacks on Kyiv
articles.summary: Russia conducted one of its heaviest bombardments on Kyiv, Ukraine, deploying hundreds of drones and missiles, including the advanced hypersonic Oreshnik. This significant four-year war escalation highlights persistent aggression and evolving modern warfare tactics, which are crucial for SSB aspirants to understand global defence dynamics and international relations.

articles.title: Pole vault national record bettered twice as Dev, Kuldeep try to outdo each other
articles.summary: On Day Three of the Federation Cup, pole vaulters Dev Meena and Kuldeep Yadav took centrestage with their impressive performances. Their efforts invigorated a day that had started slowly compared to the record-breaking Saturday. This national sporting event showcased their athletic prowess, highlighting the competitive spirit and skill within Indian sports.
